faq: Delivery within the Benelux usually takes 3 to 6 working days, within the EU 5 to 9 working days and worldwide 7 to 16 working days. Each product shows an expected delivery date for your country.
Which countries do you ship to?
We deliver to more than 30 countries, including all EU member states, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Norway, the United States, Canada, Australia and several countries in Asia and the Middle East.
Do I have to pay import duties?
Within the EU there are no additional costs: VAT is included. For deliveries outside the EU, local import duties and taxes may apply.
Which payment methods do you accept?
Credit and debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, iDEAL | Wero, Bancontact, SEPA transfer and various local payment methods.
How can I return a product?
You have a 30-day return period. Register your return with our customer service; the purchase amount is refunded within 14 days after we receive the product.
